title: The Effect of Functional Gradient Material Distribution and Patterning on Torsional Properties of Lattice Structures Manufactured Using MultiJet Fusion Technology
summary: Investigation of how spatial density variation and lattice patterning affect twisting resistance, energy absorption and failure behavior in additively manufactured cellular structures.

title: Investigation of torsional properties of surface- and strut-based lattice structures manufactured using multiJet fusion technology
summary: Experimental comparison of three cellular geometries under twisting loads, including the relationship between topology, rigidity, energy dissipation and fracture characteristics. The study also introduces an analytical approach accounting for varying structural cross-sections.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

title: Metal hybrid additive manufacturing: state-of-the-art
summary: A review of manufacturing approaches combining additive and conventional processes, examining existing hybrid technologies and their potential benefits for manufacturing efficiency and component quality.
